value.answer: Google's Gemini 3.7 Flash targets coding and agents with a 50% introductory price cut, offering $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens through the end of 2026. The model emphasizes more diligent planning and execution, aiming for fewer retries and less manual supervision. This discount is available until December 31, 2026, for teams that migrate to the model by then.
